answer: Darky here: each earning seat is bound to one mobile number. At a random minute each epoch the network asks the carrier for a signed IMSI assertion and texts a challenge to return in 90 seconds. Each number and SIM backs only one seat; a second claim burns both 100 POA bonds. A farm of 80 clones needs 80 live contract SIMs, about £800 a month, plus 8,000 POA at risk. The carrier stamps an ember serial on the assertion. A nebula of prepay SIMs from one batch, or activated in the same gale, counts as one operator. - Darky from Rare Pepe
